title: U.S. 1 #12 Marvel 1984 Final Last Issue Ulysses Solomon Archer Trucker Comic
conditionDescription: Reading copy: piece missing from front cover bottom right corner; back cover torn and folded at upper left, with creasing. See photos.
descriptionText:
U.S. 1 #12 (October 1984), Marvel Comics - the final issue of the series, "The Truck Stops Here!" Written by Bill Mantlo. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Dreadstar by Jim Starlin (Epic Comics) ad.

Condition: reading copy. A piece is missing from the bottom right corner of the front cover, and the back cover is torn and folded over at the upper left, with a crease running across it (see photos). Interior intact.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
